title: QuickWizard correction
body:
AAPS 3.3.2.1

Hi, 
please check: In QuickWizard, we have a different correction percentage set than in the global setting. However, when feeding through a "pretzel", it takes the global setting into the calculation.

Thx.

Marián

comments.body: Hi. I tried to reproduce this, but I'm not able to on latest dev or 3.3.2.1

I recorded in AAPS Client, but it's the same on mobile in AAPS.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f7fd7c5-eeb9-43a4-81a4-2a517440d415

I cannot replicate this issue as well.
Try to remove QuickWizard record Obed and create it again

Deleting and re-creating it fixed the problem. There must have been some problem with the update to 3.3.2.1

Thank you.
